purpose: Track A: improve the Double Heston PINN as a numerical surrogate for exact Double Heston, via a predeclared ablation ladder of small research-backed changes. Track B: a clearly labelled hybrid, the fixed-parameter pricing prior plus a tiny bounded market-residual head, with the identical residual head given to Black-Scholes and Single Heston priors. Frozen before any v5 training.

inherited_frozen.collocation_pool_seed: reuse of the v4 sampler with new seeds for the RAD pool
inherited_frozen.engine: nifty_multifactor_v4/literature_exact.py (exact Fourier teacher) and src/mentor_dh_pinn/regular_pinn_torch.py (features, analytic baseline, PDE residual)
inherited_frozen.locked_baseline: nifty_multifactor_v4 candidate C3, width 256, depth 5, seeds 17 and 43

development.use: ONLY for choosing the ablation winner and Track B hyper-parameters

final_fidelity.use: UNTOUCHED until the final architecture is frozen; opened once

pde_final.use: PDE residual on the final architecture only

ablation.budget: IDENTICAL for every stage: seed 17 only, 12,000 Adam steps, lr 1e-3 cosine to 1e-5, 512 label and 128 physics points per step, then 300 L-BFGS steps. The locked C3 recipe (40,000 steps, two seeds) is reported alongside but is NOT the ablation budget.

stages.A0: baseline architecture: features -> Linear(24,W) -> [tanh -> Linear(W,W)] x4 -> tanh -> head. Plain tanh stack, exactly the locked design, retrained at the ablation budget.
stages.A1: A0 + residual blocks: projection to width W, then h <- h + alpha_l * tanh(Linear(h)), alpha_l learned per block, initialised 0.1.
stages.A2: A1 + layer-wise adaptive tanh: tanh(a_l * z) with one learned scalar a_l per block, initialised 1.0 (Jagtap et al.).
stages.A3: A2 + gradient-norm loss balancing (Wang, Teng & Perdikaris learning-rate annealing): every 100 steps, w_i <- 0.9 w_i + 0.1 * max_grad_norm(price term) / mean_grad_norm(term i), applied to the IV, PDE and convexity terms; price weight fixed at 1.
stages.A4: A3 + residual-adaptive physics sampling (RAD): every 2,000 steps resample the 18,000 active collocation points from the pool, half uniform-stratified and half with probability proportional to |PDE residual| + c.
stages.A5: A4 but with the gated block of Wang, Teng & Perdikaris in place of the residual block: U, V encoders shared across depth, Z = tanh(Linear(h)), h <- (1-Z)*U + Z*V.

ablation.parameter_budget: no stage may exceed 1.2x the locked C3 parameter count (269,825).
ablation.selection_rule: The winner is the stage with the lowest DEVELOPMENT forward-price RMSE. If a simpler earlier stage is within 5% of the best, the simpler stage wins. No other candidates are trained.
ablation.final_training: The winning architecture is retrained at the FULL locked recipe (40,000 Adam steps, seeds 17 and 43, two-seed mean) and only then is the final fidelity set opened.

pure_pinn_targets.note: targets, not values to be forced; the actual result is reported either way

stopping_rule: Once the PINN-vs-exact-DH IV RMSE is below 0.07 vol points, architecture work stops and the remaining market error is attributed, with numbers, to model misspecification rather than network error.

track_b.label: DH_PINN_RESIDUAL — physics prior plus a small ML residual correction. NOT exact Double Heston.
track_b.split: One frozen structured split of the SPX surface from hardcoded_v1: rank expiries by maturity and, within each expiry, rank strikes. A quote is CALIBRATION if (expiry_rank + strike_rank) is even, HELD OUT otherwise. Within calibration, quotes whose strike rank is a multiple of 5 form the DEVELOPMENT subset used for the residual hyper-parameters. Hashes recorded before any residual training.
track_b.prior: For each of BS, SH and DH, the level scale s is fitted on CALIBRATION quotes only, with the same bounded search as hardcoded_v1. Structural parameters stay at the published values.
track_b.residual_head: Identical for all three priors: inputs [x, log tau, prior IV, x/sqrt(tau)], standardised by calibration statistics; Linear(4,64) -> tanh -> Linear(64,64) -> tanh -> Linear(64,1); output delta_IV = delta_max * tanh(.), added to the prior IV, then priced with Black.
track_b.training: Identical for all three priors: Adam, 4,000 steps, lr 3e-3 cosine to 1e-4, full-batch calibration quotes, loss = mean squared IV error + lambda * mean(delta_IV^2), lambda = 0.05.
track_b.delta_max: chosen on the DEVELOPMENT subset from {0.02, 0.05, 0.10} in volatility units, the same grid for all three priors.
track_b.no_arbitrage: The hybrid surface is checked for monotonicity and convexity in strike and monotone total variance in maturity; violations are counted and reported, never silently clipped.
track_b.statistics: Paired differences per (expiry x moneyness) cell on held-out quotes, cluster bootstrap over cells with 5,000 replicates, seed 20260920, plus the fraction of cells won.

integrity: The final fidelity set is opened once, after the architecture is frozen.
The held-out SPX quotes are never used for training, hyper-parameters or architecture choice.
Every ablation stage uses an identical training budget and the same data.
Black-Scholes and Single Heston receive exactly the same residual head, optimiser and data as Double Heston.
Failed stages are retained and reported.
Crypto surfaces are secondary stress tests only; results outside the trained level range are labelled out-of-domain.
